source: Kitewing customer benchmarks 2024-2026 (synthetic) — medians across customers in each segment before go-live.
realisation_note: Only 40% of freed technician and office capacity is counted as value (conservative: not every saved hour becomes a billable job or avoided cost). Overtime counts only the overtime premium.

drive_time_reduction_pct.basis: Conservative vs. 18% measured at Copperline (CS-02) with Route Optimizer.

assist_extra_ftf_pts.basis: Summit Ridge (CS-03): 35% fewer technician calls to the office with Assist.

overtime_reduction_pct.basis: Conservative vs. -22% at Greystone (CS-01); only the 50% overtime premium is counted.

overtime_premium.basis: Time-and-a-half: the saving is the premium, the work itself still happens.

admin_time_reduction_pct.basis: Meadowlark (CS-05) saved 12 h/week with 3 office staff (about 33%).

dso_reduction_days.basis: Conservative vs. -18 days at Summit Ridge (CS-03).

cost_of_capital_pct.basis: Annual value of cash released by faster invoicing.

internal_training_hours_per_tech.basis: Technician training and ride-alongs during rollout (internal cost of the investment).

internal_hours_per_office_staff.basis: Dispatcher/office configuration workshops, testing and training.
